Persistent session/refresh state, transport, nullable expiries and issue time match SQL. Android and legacy JWT subject/session/lifetime are checked; Web has protected host cookies and the exact session view, no returned tokens. Other account and contact/password data are absent.

Correct account credentials succeed for every supported role. Wrong password, unknown account, pending/suspended account deny401 with endpoint-specific frozen error code; Web login without CSRF denies403. No rejected request creates a session/refresh token, receipt, audit or LastLoginAt.

Current inactive role catalog denies401 with exact endpoint error and no session/token, LastLoginAt or audit. Reactivation permits a fresh successful login for the same actor and exactly one session/token pair.

testAssertions.assertion: Login is a fresh account-credential exchange: revoking previous session/token pairs leaves them revoked while a new login creates one live pair. Pending/suspended current account denial is separately executed; no revoked credential is revived.
Current Pending/Suspended account credentials deny401 without a session/token, audit, receipt or LastLoginAt; malformed and unknown credentials do not establish authority.

Current inactive role catalog denies401 with exact endpoint error and no session/token, LastLoginAt or audit. Reactivation permits a fresh successful login for the same actor and exactly one session/token pair.

Each supported role receives200 JSON/no-store/correlation and exact finite login/user property sets with current SQL ID, displayName, canonical role and version. Persistent session/refresh state, transport, nullable expiries and issue time match SQL. Android and legacy JWT subject/session/lifetime are checked; Web has protected host cookies and the exact session view, no returned tokens. Other account and contact/password data are absent.

Successful responses expose exactly frozen login/user fields, current actor data and no email/phone/password/other account. Web cookies are Secure/HttpOnly/SameSiteLax host cookies and token-free response; token responses are no-store and only hashes persist. Credential, validation and inactive-state failures disclose neither actor email nor submitted passwords/tokens, and return finite error semantics.

Successful, concurrent-conflicting and fresh post-revocation logins write no AuditLog or idempotency receipt for the actor. This preserves inspected absence of a login business-audit producer; LastLoginAt remains persisted separately.

Future/expired/ended primary membership, suspended primary account and role mismatch all yield null primary and no current roster row.

Both directory and roster page three unique persisted rows with limit1, reject changed-filter cursor and listed invalid limit/cursor/role/status values.

Actual cookie and Bearer succeed on all four staff reads before SQL session revocation; both deny all four fresh requests after revocation.
Current PM reads succeed; future/expired/ended/wrong-role current membership denies both project reads on every request. Suspended PM denies roster.
